  • Support data quality and governance initiatives.

Experience –

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience or equivalent in Mathematics, Statistics, Computer Science, Engineering, Economics, or a related quantitative field.
  • Experience in data analysis, reporting, and visualisation using SQL, Python, Power BI.
  • Demonstrated ability to design data stories that simplify complex concepts and clearly communicate insights to senior leaders and business teams.
  • Good understanding of data structures, models, and processes.
  • Experience working in Cloud Environments preferably Databricks and AWS
  • Good communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to present / communicate complex data clearly.
  • Proven track record in analyzing data using statistical and machine learning techniques
  • Curiosity and passion for data, problem-solving, and continuous learning.
  • Knowledge of the electric vehicle and renewable energy sector is desirable but not essential.
  • Self-starter mentality and passionate about continuous improvement and process efficiency

Work with IRDAI-published data to analyse market share, competition movement, product trends, and industry shifts. Support regulatory reporting and business insights derived from industry datasets.

4. Dashboarding & Reporting
Build, enhance, and maintain dashboards on Power BI/Tableau to track KPIs, business performance, and forecasting trends. Automate recurring performance reports, MIS, and data refreshes.

5. Collaboration & Communication
Partner with product, sales, and business teams to frame analytical problems and present insights effectively. Communicate findings in a clear, concise, and business-friendly manner.

6. Data Quality, Governance & Documentation
Ensure accuracy, consistency, and hygiene across datasets. Maintain documentation of analytics processes, metrics definitions, and reporting frameworks.

Role Overview

We are looking for a sharp, detail-oriented MIS Executive to manage data reporting for our South Cluster. In this role, you won't just move numbers aroundyou will build the tools and reports that help our leadership team make the right decisions. We need someone who is fast, technically skilled, and obsessed with accuracy.

Excel Mastery (The "Power User")

You don’t just "use" Excel; you command it. We need someone who can build robust, scalable workbooks that don't break when a new row is added.

  • Advanced Logic: Proficient in complex formulas (XLOOKUP, INDEX/MATCH, Let/Lambda functions).

  • Data Structuring: An intuitive understanding of how to organize data for long-term usability.

SQL & Database Fluency

You are comfortable communicating directly with our databases to get the answers you need.

  • Query Writing: Ability to write clean, efficient SQL to extract, join, and filter data from multiple tables.
  • Data Integrity: Knowledge of how to validate source data to ensure your "pull" matches reality.

Data Visualization (Power BI / Tableau / Looker)

Data is only useful if people understand it. You should have a grasp of at least one major BI tool (preferably Power BI).

  • Dashboard Design: Ability to turn complex datasets into intuitive, visual stories.
  • Metric Definition: Experience building DAX measures or calculated fields that reflect business KPIs accurately.

AI-Augmented Productivity

We value efficiency over "doing it the hard way." You should be an early adopter of AI tools to enhance your workflow.

  • Prompt Engineering: Using LLMs (like ChatGPT or Gemini) to troubleshoot code, write complex Regex, or brainstorm data models.
  • Automation Mindset: Leveraging AI to speed up repetitive tasks, from drafting documentation to refactoring SQL queries.

Radical Attention to Detail

You are your own toughest critic. You treat every stakeholder report as a reflection of your professional brand.

  • Error Detection: You proactively catch "silent errors" (like duplicates or null values) before they reach the final presentation.
  • The "Sanity Check": You always ask, "Does this number actually make sense?" before hitting send.

Why Join Us?

You will play a key role in how our South Cluster operates. If you enjoy solving problems with data and take pride in producing "perfect" reports, you’ll fit right in.

Skills and experience that will lead to success

  • 3-5 years of experience in metadata management
  • Understanding of metadata management and data catalogue solutions to make data sources searchable
  • Familiarity with insurance industry data standards and practices
  • Experience of data lineage tracking and preferably SQL skills for metadata querying and analysis
  • Good written documentation and verbal communication skills to promote the benefits of metadata management to internal stakeholders
  • High level of accuracy and attention to detail in curating data and experience with business glossary development and maintenance
  • Knowledge of the complementary roles of technology, data management and data governance teams
  • Good analytical and problem-solving skills

Overview
We are seeking a highly skilled Data Analyst to design, develop, and deliver actionable analytics for a cloud-native US Healthcare Revenue Cycle Management (RCM) platform. This role focuses on data analysis, BI, dashboards, automation, and reporting across Claims, Prior Authorization, Scheduling, Coding, Collections, Payments, Denials, AR, and EDI. You will work closely with Product, Engineering, Data Engineering, DBA, AI/ML, RPA, DevOps, Compliance, and Operations teams to deliver real-time, secure, and compliance-ready analytics.

Job Roles Responsibilities

Data Analysis Reporting

  • Analyze operational, financial, and clinical data across RCM workflows to provide actionable insights.
  • Write advanced SQL queries and generate reports from SQL Server, Snowflake, and Redshift.
  • Develop Power BI dashboards and reports for internal teams and external stakeholders.
  • Leverage Excel, Power Query, pivot tables, and formulas for deep-dive analysis.
  • Prepare stakeholder-ready PowerPoint presentations and Word documentation summarizing trends and insights.

AI/ML Automation Enablement

  • Collaborate with AI/ML, GenAI, Agentic AI, and RPA teams to provide curated datasets for model training and validation.
  • Build dashboards tracking predictive insights, AI model outputs, and automation exceptions.
  • Enable actionable insights to trigger operational workflows through Power Automate and enterprise automation.

RCM EDI Analytics

  • Work with Claims, Prior Authorization, Coding, Collections, Payments, Denials, AR, and EDI (837, 835, 270/271, 276/277, 278) data to deliver operational intelligence.
  • Conduct root-cause analysis to identify revenue leakage, payer performance issues, and process inefficiencies.

Collaboration Stakeholder Engagement

  • Partner with Product Managers, Operations, Finance, and AI/ML teams to align analytics with business goals.
  • Support self-service analytics adoption for operational and management teams.
  • Communicate insights effectively using data storytelling, dashboards, and presentations.

Data Governance Compliance

  • Ensure analytics solutions comply with HIPAA, SOC 2, and internal security policies.
  • Implement role-based access controls (RBAC), PHI masking, and audit-ready reporting.
  • Document data sources, metrics definitions, and reporting logic to maintain traceability.
Experience
Bachelor's or Master's degree in Data Analytics, Statistics, Computer Science, Information Systems, or related fields.
3-6+ years of experience in data analysis, BI, or analytics roles.
Hands-on experience with Power BI, Tableau, SQL Server, Snowflake, Redshift.
Strong proficiency in Excel, Power Query, pivot tables, formulas, and PowerPoint presentations.
Exposure to AI/ML, GenAI, Agentic AI, or RPA-driven analytics is a plus.
Experience in US Healthcare, RCM, or other regulated domains is preferred.

BI Visualization Tools: Power BI, Tableau, Looker, Power Automate
RCM EDI Analytics: 837, 835, 270/271, 276/277, 278

Cloud Awareness: AWS, Azure, GCP (analytics security awareness)
Data Governance Security: HIPAA, SOC 2, RBAC, PHI masking, audit-ready reporting
Office Productivity: Advanced Excel, PowerPoint, Word, including pivot tables, formulas, dashboards, and presentations
Integration Pipelines: Microservices, APIs, event-driven data pipelines Skillset:
Strong data analysis, problem-solving, and visualization skills.
Ability to translate complex RCM workflows, AI outputs, and analytics into actionable insights.
Experience collaborating with cross-functional teams including AI, RPA, DevOps, and product.
Excellent communication, presentation, and stakeholder engagement skills.
Attention to detail, compliance awareness, and audit-ready reporting mindset.
Strategic Impact:
Deliver accurate and actionable analytics to improve operational efficiency, collections, and payer transparency.
Support AI/ML adoption and automation workflows with curated data and performance dashboards.
Enable real-time insights and data-driven decision-making across RCM modules.
Improve operational KPIs, reduce revenue leakage, and strengthen compliance and audit readiness.

The Opportunity We are looking for a sharp Data Analyst who thrives on open-ended problem-solving. Instead of answering pre-packaged questions or staring at standing dashboards, you will be handed raw data and complex industrial datasets (sensor streams across speed, pressure, temperature, flow, and vibration) to figure out what is actually happening.   • Python Proficiency: Daily comfort with Python (pandas, numpy, and basic scipy for statistical checks) as a core analytical tool.
  • Time-Series Experience: Comfort working with sequential data indexed over time, spotting trends, seasonality, and drift.
  • Hypothesis-Driven Mindset: A natural reflex to form testable explanations when encountering anomalies rather than random searching.
  • Comfort with Ambiguity: Ability to take a vague prompt and turn it into a rigorous, structured investigation.

Strong Signals

  • Exposure to real equipment, IoT, SCADA, or industrial sensor streams.
  • Curiosity about product and user behavior analytics.

Summary:


  • Role type : Contractor
  • Engagement window: Full-time during the base-brain build (Aug-Dec) fractional ongoing (Jan-Apr)
  • Location: Tier-1 India (Bangalore • Hyderabad • Chennai • Pune • Mumbai • Delhi NCR); remote-friendly
  • Reports to : CTO
  • Team : Likely a lead Data Analyst + AI, scaling to a small pool for the global expansion

About the role


The Data Analyst is the primary resource who marshals the documentation that builds the platform's base Brain. The Brain produces a credible screening PCF by ontological equivalence estimating a supplier's missing data from comparable suppliers (same material process country). That only works once a reference base (~1,500 suppliers) populates the equivalence space. Building that base is what makes meaningful output possible for any customer so this role is foundational and on the critical path.

The platform serves automotive OEMs and their Tier-1 suppliers, whose supplier base is global so the base you build is global and multi-language, not India-only. You will not do this alone or by hand: you work AI-first (Claude to extract, translate and structure across languages) on the pipeline the AI/ML Platform Engineer builds, and the base is built coverage-first EU + India (the high-yield, high-relevance regions) first for general audience, then China / SE Asia / Americas as expansion. You run the ingestion; you do not build it.


Key responsibilities


Source & marshal the documentation (global)


  • Global sources EU company registers + CSRD-cascade disclosures, national registries, OEM / Tier-1 supplier portals, India (BRSR / MCA), Japan / Korea filings, industry associations and global databases per the approved-source registry.
  • Multi-language, AI-first — use Claude to extract, translate and structure non-English sources at scale; you curate and QA, the AI does the volume.
  • IP discipline — ingest derived attributes only; never redistribute source documents; every field carries a source and confidence tier (A/B/C).

Build the base — coverage-first


  • EU + India first — build coverage of the equivalence neighbourhoods (material process country) for OEM/Tier-1 suppliers in the high-yield regions first, so the platform can ride on a covered sub-footprint.
  • Default-anchor the hard regions — where public data is sparse (China, SE Asia, N. Africa), anchor with regional / sector defaults + a few representative suppliers rather than fully sourcing each; improve as primary data arrives.
  • Structure & resolve — normalize into the L2 schema; resolve entity-resolution and source-format exceptions; one canonical profile per supplier.

Quality, provenance & drift


  • QA against the golden set — check profiles within tolerance; triage and flag gap-fills; keep provenance + tier on every field.
  • Monitor drift — watch source-format changes across regions; keep the source registry current.

What success looks like — coverage-driven phasing


  • Foundation (10) — taxonomy, ingest contract, entity-ID and gates frozen; per-region automated yield measured; golden set seeded.
  • 50 — cohort model proven; EU + India yield confirmed on real cohorts.
  • ~150 — EU + India core equivalence neighborhoods started; first meaningful screening outputs.
  • ~500 (GA-ready) — EU + India covered credible screening PCFs for EU + India suppliers.
  • GA-usefulness threshold.
  • 800 1,500 (post-GA) — add China / SE Asia / Americas — multi-language, default-anchored where data is sparse.


Required qualifications


  • Data literacy — spreadsheets and SQL; some Python a plus; can structure messy source data into a defined schema.
  • Research & sourcing skill across jurisdictions — finding and extracting the right data from reports, filings and portals; strong attention to detail.
  • AI-first working — fluent using Claude and similar to extract, translate and structure at scale, with human judgement on exceptions and QA.
  • Comfort with multi-language sources (via AI translation); rigour on provenance (source • date • confidence tier).
  • Willingness to learn the carbon / LCA and automotive supply-chain domain; 2–4 years in a data / research / analyst / operations role; volume data collection & QA a strong plus.


Boundaries


  • Owns — sourcing, structuring and QA of the global base-Brain data.
  • Not this role — building the ingestion pipeline or L4 (AI/ML Platform Engineer); taxonomy / methodology governance (CTO); the programme (PM); the customer-facing product (Product Engineer).
  • Seam — operates the pipeline the AI/ML Platform Engineer builds; escalates taxonomy questions to the CTO

We are seeking a highly analytical and detail-oriented Data Consumer Analyst to support a strategic migration from an on-premises data warehouse to a modern AWS S3-based cloud data platform. In this role, you will be responsible for discovering, documenting, and analyzing all data consumers, dependencies, reports, applications, and business processes that rely on the existing data ecosystem.

You will work closely with business stakeholders, BI teams, data engineers, architects, and application owners to ensure a seamless migration with minimal business disruption.

  • Perform end-to-end data lineage analysis and document data flow from source systems through transformations to consumption layers.
  • Analyze database objects, ETL processes, reporting assets, and downstream dependencies to understand migration impacts.
  • Review query logs, access patterns, and usage metrics to distinguish active data assets from obsolete or redundant ones.
  • Collaborate with business and technical stakeholders to validate data dependencies and usage requirements.
  • Create and maintain detailed dependency maps, consumer catalogs, migration inventories, and risk assessments.
  • Support migration planning by identifying critical business processes and potential risks prior to cutover.
